_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id}, yana wasa da zagaye {num_rounds} na Iterated Ultimatum Game. Kuna da ${pool} don raba wannan zagaye tsakanin ku da Mai kunnawa {other_id}. Mai ba da shawara: - Yi tayin: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool) - Idan an karɓa → Kuna samun $ ((pool - X), wani ɗan wasan yana samun $ X - Idan an ƙi → Dukansu suna samun $ 0 - Misali: [Offer: $3] ko 'Ina tsammanin wannan daidai ne. [Offer: $5]' Mai amsawa: - yanke shawara game da tayin tare da ko dai [Accept] ko [Reject] - Misali: 'Wannan yana da kyau. [Accept]' 'Ba daidai ba ne. [Reject]'

round.begins: --- Zagaye {round_number} ya fara! --- Mai kunnawa {proposer_id} shine mai ba da shawara, Mai kunnawa {responder_id} shine mai amsawa.
round.offer: Zagaye {round_number}: Mai kunnawa {proposer_id} yana ba da ${offer} ga Mai kunnawa {responder_id} (yana riƙe da ${keep}).
round.accepted: Mai kunnawa {responder_id} an karɓa! Zagaye {round_number} ya samu: Mai kunnawa {proposer_id} + ${proposer_gain}, Mai kunnawa {responder_id} + ${responder_gain}. Sabbin jimloli: Mai kunnawa 0: ${total_0}, Mai kunnawa 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Mai kunnawa {responder_id} ya ƙi tayin! Zagaye {round_number} ya samu: 'Yan wasa biyu + $ 0. Jimlar ta kasance: Mai kunnawa 0: ${total_0}, Mai kunnawa 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Mai ba da shawara dole ne ya yi tayin ta amfani da tsari [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Adadin tayin dole ne ya zama cikakkiyar lamba.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Dole ne tayin ya kasance tsakanin $ 0 da ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Babu wani tayin da za a amsa a yanzu.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Dole ne mai amsawa ya [Accept] ko [Reject] tayin.

outcome.win: Mai kunnawa {winner} ya ci nasara tare da ${winner_total} jimlar vs Mai kunnawa {loser} na ${loser_total} .
outcome.draw: Duka 'yan wasan sun gama da $ {total} duka.
